title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 22: Responsibility

scenes.say: Home office. Night. War photos. Books. His daughter's drawings.
scenes.visual: a home desk at night with photos, books and a child's drawings, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He writes: Chapter One. The Hood Raised Me, But the Army Changed Me.
scenes.visual: a hand writing in a notebook under a desk lamp, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We gotta own our pain, or someone else will profit off it.
scenes.visual: a stack of handwritten pages, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Family court. His daughter sits beside him.
scenes.visual: a father and young daughter sitting together in a courtroom, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Mr. Torres, you've shown growth and stability. Full visitation granted.
scenes.visual: a judge's gavel resting on a bench, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali closes his eyes. Redemption looks a lot like responsibility.
scenes.visual: a man exhaling with eyes closed, soft light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A grassy field at sunset. Ali and his daughter fly a kite.
scenes.visual: a father and daughter flying a kite in a field at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I love when you're here, Daddy. I love being here, baby girl.
scenes.visual: a little girl running ahead holding a kite string, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She saved me, without even knowing.
scenes.visual: a kite high in a golden sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Three. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a kite string against the sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 22 of 25: Responsibility. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
